judge.name: Contributor 54
judge.method: One exhaustive read of each artifact against the current bar, vendored Machines API schema and primary Fly documentation; no authored files changed and no walk or tests run.

doubts.reason: This is an explicitly fake-pool API journey. The local image and forwarded ports establish simulated contract data; they do not verify the guest process or a reconnection. Step 19 captures only the resumed instance despite its connection wording.

Pending_destroy is a vendor-supported soft-deletion state, but disappearance after 24h is the disclosed World simulation, not a vendor SLA. Vendor evidence: https://community.fly.io/t/volume-stuck-in-pending-destroy-for-11-hours/14743

Exact equality of the entire config is stricter than checking the supplied fields and may reject vendor-added optional defaults such as dns. The page sample includes dns although the request omitted it; the spec does not make that additional field mandatory, so this is a doubt, not a contradiction ruling.

reviewed.conclusion: Each of the 29 steps was read exactly once against every item of the bar. The app probe has a shown provisioning cause; the attached-volume refusal has the extant attachment as its cause; stop/start happen in different sittings; monitors have separate information needs; IDs and token are captured; waits use the documented instance ID when waiting for stopped.
